title: Geometry / 2x Grid

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Relate spacing and scale to a common structure and viewing distance, so viewers can follow content across very different formats.
strategic_value: The same divisions-of-two logic can connect IBM interfaces, printed pieces and physical environments without requiring identical compositions.
demonstration: The page pairs grid construction media states and diagrams with application examples, base-unit and viewing-distance tables, spatial multiples and a video-format grid.
practical_value: Choose margins, gutters and an appropriate base unit for the medium before composing content and setting type.

content_islands.name: Framework and applications
content_islands.spec: Open with the 2x Grid introduction and media states, then show varied applications under the divisions-of-two explanation.

content_islands.name: Grid construction
content_islands.spec: Compare margin and gutter configurations; follow with rows, columns and evenly distributed gutter examples.

content_islands.name: Base units
content_islands.spec: Present the base-unit media state, mini-unit viewing-distance diagram and table, followed by baseline and hybrid grid examples.

content_islands.name: Spatial and aspect relationships
content_islands.spec: Show the spacing-multiple progression, banner and letterhead examples, and aspect-ratio diagram.

content_islands.name: Digital and video adaptation
content_islands.spec: Close with a UI grid example and the dedicated 1920×1080 video grid and template resource.

ingredient.name: 2x Grid base unit
ingredient.role: Establish consistent spatial relationships at the scale people encounter them.
ingredient.application: Divide the live area into equal rows or columns; choose a mini or baseline unit; use the source spacing multiples and select the mini unit for the viewing distance.
ingredient.scope: Print mini units vary with distance. Product and web use an 8px mini unit. The standard 1920×1080 video adaptation uses 7.5px, with recommended 30px alignment increments.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction explains that structure frees attention for the creative idea; base-unit guidance connects scale to legibility over distance.
reference_purposes.Expression: Application images show the same grid logic across print, screens and spatial work.
reference_purposes.Application: Construction diagrams and tables teach margins, columns, gutters, base units and spacing multiples.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source requires equal rows and columns, specifies dividing the live area when margins exist, and distinguishes the 8px product/web mini unit from the 7.5px unit for 1920×1080 video.
